steps.label: Report the Disgraced Ruins founder's defeat at the Recruitment Centre.
Courage reaches rank 5 (Heroic).
Ask the Grand Cathedral guard about Neuras' stolen relics.
Persuade Eupha that the Sanctists will listen (Follower rank 7).

At Arenafront Wharf, hand every collected Gold Beetle to the Elderly Entomophile and claim his remaining rewards, Flameseal Corselet and Dragon's Fall — all possible beetle exchanges are now complete.

guidanceSections.title: Exchange requirement
guidanceSections.body: The reward track needs 46 Gold Beetles in total, rather than every beetle in the game. Claim each remaining reward from the Elderly Entomophile; later optional beetle pickups may still appear in the route.

steps.label: Join Alonzo for his final act in Brilehaven (Follower rank 7).
Help Basilio stop Vinca; receive 'A Brother's Mercy' (Follower rank 7).
Watch 'The Stripling and His Stewards' at the reopened Opera House.
Eloquence reaches rank 5 (Rhetorician).
Harvest the Plant Culture Chamber — a Tail Bait may turn up — then hear Eupha out (Follower rank 8).
Clear the Manor of the Ascendant; find its Gold Beetle through the crawl space after the first ladder, then slay the Kokamordos.
Report the Kokamordos kill at the Recruitment Centre.
Face Vinca with Basilio — no weaknesses and resistant to all physical damage; completing 'A Brother's Mercy' raises Basilio to Follower rank 8.
Speak with Daturam in Brilehaven about Alonzo (Follower rank 8); receive 'A Rake's Last Wish'.
Chase the stolen relics to Jin's runner; do the laundry for bonus max MP and steal the Fortune God's Abacus if desired.
Recover the relics from Jin (Follower rank 8 for Neuras) — all Followers are now rank 8.
Deliver Alonzo's inheritance to his hometown to conclude 'A Rake's Last Wish'.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Bronze II → Bronze I.
Depart for the Abandoned Path; the travel block is free time, so use any remaining Gauntlet Runner activity (the source route sleeps).
At camp, read Neuras' final decrypted journal entry in the Engine Room Corridor, then use another free-time activity if desired.
Use the travel free-time block as desired (the source route does laundry).
Clear the Abandoned Path — hug the left wall to the north-centre section for its Gold Beetle; Catherina removes roughly half the boss's HP.
Report the final bounty request at the Recruitment Centre.
Purify Crimson Split Shoes at St. Fermis Church for the coming dragon trials.
Travel to the Forsaken Tower and defeat the Devourer of Nations; avoid relying on null/repel effects because its counter grants extra actions.
Set off for the Tower of Insolence; use the travel free-time block as desired, then stop at the Decaying Estate.
Climb the Tower of Insolence with Catherina; collect the Gold Beetle beside the central railing on floor 2, defeat Ziocropos, then defeat the Almighty-only Devourer of Stars.

guidanceSections.title: Tower pickup
guidanceSections.body: The beetle is on floor 2 beside the central railing to the north. Ziocropos comes before the dragon.

guidanceSections.title: Dragon preparation
guidanceSections.body: Bring Hex recovery and Almighty damage or a way to apply a temporary weakness. Keep enemy attack buffs under control; the dragon can remove buffs and debuffs.

steps.label: Give Maria the remaining Neuras drawings to hang at the Hushed Honeybee Inn, then ask Edeni to clear the Spire of Blind Faith's bad weather.
On the Gauntlet Runner, hone your weapon with Strohl before the tower.
Climb the Spire of Blind Faith and defeat the Devourer of Flames; the three defeated dragons unseal the Dragon Temple and unlock 'Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power'.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Bronze I → Silver III.
Report the Ziocropos defeat to the Obsessive Soldier at Opera House Square.
Soak in the Altabury hot spring and collect spring water in the empty vial for the Gentle Merchant's request.
Return the hot-spring water to the Gentle Merchant at Blue Sky Bridge; he gives the route's final Gold Beetle.
Use the Dragon Temple travel block for free time (the source route fishes with Tail Bait for a Lord of the Lake and Queen's Honey Jars).
At the Dragon Temple's Divine Altar Path, complete 'Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power' by defeating the Elegy of the Soul; do not equip Repel gear for this fight.

guidanceSections.title: Equipment check
guidanceSections.body: Remove equipment with Repel effects before entering. Null effects are allowed. Bring a planned damage rotation and recovery so the fight does not drag on.

steps.label: Craft the Masked Dancer masks and Summoner vessels you can make; before Skybound Avatar, the only planned missing vessel material is a Talisman of the Divine.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Silver III → Silver II.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Silver II → Silver I.
Blight weather blocks the coliseum; hear the Nostalgic Elder's Thief King tale in Martira instead.
At night in Brilehaven, hear the Masked Woman who appears at Angler's Inn Square.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Silver I → Gold III; the Brawler-restricted bout is weak to Light and Strike.
Varmareno Coliseum Gold Gauntlet — clear all 30 rounds of 'The Furthest Reach' consecutively.

guidanceSections.title: One continuous run
guidanceSections.body: Finish all 30 Gold Gauntlet rounds consecutively for The Furthest Reach. Prepare recovery supplies before starting this separate challenge.

steps.label: Storm the Skybound Avatar to stop Louis — thoroughly sweep its chests and loot, including any remaining Talisman materials needed for the summoning vessels.
Break the King's Servants, defeat Zorba, refuse Louis' offer in the throne room, and complete the Skybound Avatar operation.
The final operation, 'Save the Country', begins at night.
The decisive battle is ten days away. If any Masked Dancer masks or Summoner vessels remain, finish crafting them now that Skybound Avatar materials are available.

guidanceSections.title: Crafting checklist
guidanceSections.body: Review the Masked Dancer masks and Summoner vessels you still need. Skybound Avatar supplies the remaining materials; verify the crafted items in-game rather than treating this route reminder as ownership proof.

steps.label: Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Gold III → Gold II (Lina).
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: Gold II → Gold I.
Varmareno Coliseum Ranked League: defeat Hómo Luano, which resists everything except Almighty, to finish the Ranked League.
Accept 'Become Champion of the Coliseum', then defeat the Gupatauron within two turns at night to complete the coliseum's final request.
Take the Bullish Youth's diving competition at Brilehaven's west docks.
Hear the Nostalgic Elder finish the Thief King and elda's bread tale in Martira.
Build the Clumsy Man's cat-like snowman: round and paunchy, pointy headscarf, and make it feel alive.
Hear the Sanctor's first folklore tale at Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square.
Donate 250 reeve to the Upper Blue Sky Bridge Activist Woman — receive Fruit Cordial.
At night, speak with the Maskless Mustari in Lower Blue Sky Bridge about how the mustari survive in Altabury.
Return to the Brilehaven Sanctor and hear the rest of his folklore tale.
Hear the Chipper Old Woman's story about an old paripus and a fairy on Dia Franco Street.
Explain the mustari relic to the Masked Woman in Martira.
Return to the Chipper Old Woman in Altabury and hear the rest of her story.
Camp at Lone Isle and meditate with Eupha (answer: breathe deeply).
Listen to Junah sing around the campfire (answer: your singing now).
Last day before the Tyrant's Star — final Idlesday toilet bonus (+1 Luck); return from Lone Isle to Grand Trad during the afternoon.

guidanceSections.title: Last preparation day
guidanceSections.body: Take the final Idlesday toilet bonus before leaving the runner. Return to Grand Trad during the afternoon so the last shopping and Follower visits remain reachable.

steps.label: Check the King's Rock one last time, finish shopping, and speak with every Follower for their final dialogue and keepsakes.
Final Pantry check, then set course for the Tyrant's Star — there is no turning back; Neuras sells consumables aboard.

guidanceSections.title: Point of no return
guidanceSections.body: Finish outstanding city preparations before setting course. Neuras can sell consumables aboard, but the route does not return to town after departure.

steps.label: Before the final boss rush, make a separate save if you intend to fight the strongest Destroyer Charadrius variant for Star Shatterer; leaving all six optional Diabolus Human refights alive produces that version.

guidanceSections.title: Optional strongest-boss branch
guidanceSections.body: Keep a separate save before choosing which powerful presences to defeat. Star Shatterer’s strongest variant requires leaving all six optional Diabolus Human refights alive; the normal route clears them for rewards.

steps.label: For the normal completion route, defeat the powerful presences for their rewards, then continue toward Louis.
Inside Akademeia, answer 'No! Magic hasn't been lost.' — the fight that follows is largely thematic.
Defeat Destroyer Charadrius and finish the story.

guidanceSections.title: Final preparation
guidanceSections.body: Restore HP and MP before ending the first phase. Keep healing available for the next phase and remove the boss’s offensive buffs when needed.

steps.label: After the credits, the epilogue catches up with the kingdom on Idlesday, December 35.
